accepted.label: Decision Tree Basics
accepted.description: Understanding of what a decision tree is, its purpose, and its standard symbolic representation.
coverage_criteria: Define a decision tree and explain its use in decision-making.
Identify and explain the standard symbols used in decision trees (decision nodes, chance nodes, end nodes) and the left-to-right reading convention.
accepted.merge_rationale: Both candidates cover introductory aspects of decision trees at the same definitional level. Together they form a single foundational concept encompassing definition, purpose, and notation.
